text:
Carmen Lopez: RFC follow-up: proposing minimal decision-surface + stable match-id to avoid cache churn.
Ben K: share sketch pls
Carmen Lopez: gist: split 'match' (immutable predicates) from 'score' (tunable weights). descriptors get a descriptor_v. cache key = H(match). score updates bump descriptor_v but don't evict match cache.
Carmen Lopez: example snippet: {descriptor_v:1, match:{region:[eu,us],model:mix-small}, score:{latency_penalty:120,cost_mul:1.05}, selector:{tier:dedicated, pct:10}}
Aisha Rao: how do we canary score changes?
Carmen Lopez: add selector that targets percent of traffic by tier. deterministic selection using request_id to avoid retry flapping.
Marta: current cache key is whole blob -> will invalidate too often. agree on match-hash.
Linus: evaluator perf: precompile match predicates into a trie so per-request is O(depth).
Ben K: need region-scoped determinism for selector if request affinity exists.
Aisha Rao: telemetry + sim infra needed: when descriptor_v changes emit tags old->new with route_id so canaries can pick them up and measure p95/p99.
Marta: also add compile-time validation for fallback chains (model family compatibility). runtime probes to fallback health.
Ben K: console/UX: show descriptor timeline and sim snapshot on promotion.
Carmen Lopez: plan: open follow-up RFC + PR with match-id hash, descriptor_v, selector percent logic. Ask Linus for trie spike, Marta for telemetry, Aisha for canary harness.
Linus: I can spike trie next sprint.
Marta: will add telemetry tags.
Aisha Rao: will update canary harness.
Ben K: +1
DevBot: lint:policy-descriptor warns unknown field 'selector' in schema v1 (ignore if schema update incoming).
